fichas.title: Employee washroom requirements
fichas.summary: Washrooms are required for employees exposed to health hazards, strongly odorous substances, heat, or damp. Provide one washroom for every four employees, or every five for moderately dirty work, based on the largest shift. The text also specifies shower and foot-washing provision, wash-place dimensions, and ventilation minima.

fichas.title: Washroom equipment and washing fixtures
fichas.summary: Illustrations show drinking fountains, washing troughs, foot-washing equipment, a space-saving washing fountain, foot baths, and a paper-towel and soap dispenser. The text describes allowable wash-place types and their fittings; selected legible fixture dimensions are recorded here.
